description: Minimum for account + entitlement aggregation (users, groups, licences, directory roles, app roles). Always included.

appRoles.name: User.Read.All
appRoles.why: Account aggregation, delta aggregation, get object, user group/role memberships

appRoles.name: Application.Read.All
appRoles.why: applicationRole entitlements (app roles of enterprise apps) — without it entitlement aggregation fails with 403 Authorization_RequestDenied on that object type (seen live 2026-10-08)

appRoles.name: AuditLog.Read.All
appRoles.why: signInActivity (last sign-in) on accounts; remove if not needed
